description: This file contains classes and functions for handling various test execution environments in Zephyr's Twister testing framework, including process management, serial communication, QEMU emulation, and device handling.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Base class for handling test execution environments, managing process lifecycle, and test result verification.

classes.name: BinaryHandler
classes.description: Handles execution of binary tests, including process management and output handling.

classes.name: SimulationHandler
classes.description: Specialized handler for simulation environments like Renode and native.

classes.name: DeviceHandler
classes.description: Manages device-based tests, serial communication, flashing, and device availability.

classes.name: QEMUHandler
classes.description: Manages QEMU emulation, including pipe communication, process monitoring, and test result collection.

methods.name: terminate_process
methods.description: Encapsulates process termination, including killing child processes.

methods.name: Handler.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the base handler with test instance and environment type.

methods.name: BinaryHandler.__init__
methods.description: Initializes binary test handler with additional parameters.

methods.name: SimulationHandler.__init__
methods.description: Initializes simulation environment handler for Renode or native.

methods.name: QEMUHandler.__init__
methods.description: Initializes QEMU emulation handler, setting up FIFO and PID files.
